messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate spike for /v1/generate (hosted-api). 500s from generator pool g2-us-west-1 between 2024-03-28T10:00Z-10:30Z. Impact: increased tail latency and 50% elevated error rate. Paging on-call: @alex.sre

alex.sre: on it. joining channel. any front-line mitigations in flight?

maria.platform: I saw the alerts, switching traffic off g2-us-west-1 to dedicated fallback pool now. will post steps.

alex.sre: thx. @maria.platform please confirm when rollback/reroute complete. I’ll start triage on generator instances.

maria.platform: reroute done at 10:06Z. traffic now ondedicated-1 and fallback-2. error rate dropped to ~12% from 50%.

olivia.support: heads-up: customer reports started coming in around 10:03Z, some timeouts and duplicate responses. I logged initial customer-impact note in INC-3245.

samir.sec: pinging for a sec/compliance follow-up. we need evidence collection ASAP — audit logs, request traces, and any operator console access during the window. don't take anything down that could remove logs.

alex.sre: understood. we'll avoid node reprovisioning. @audit-bot can you start a snapshot of controller logs + access logs for 10:00-10:35Z and push to secure S3 bucket?

audit-bot: Starting collection: controller logs, router access logs, model executor logs for window 2024-03-28T10:00Z to 2024-03-28T10:35Z. Will upload to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/ and send manifest when done.

maria.platform: note — k8s events show OOMKilled on generator-3 around 10:02Z, but autoscaler replaced it. unclear if it's memory or model bump.

alex.sre: copying relevant logs now. command I ran locally:

``
# fetch executor logs
kubectl --context=prod-west logs -n inference generator-3 --since=40m > /tmp/generator-3-logs.txt
# upload
aws s3 cp /tmp/generator-3-logs.txt s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/
```

samir.sec: good. also we need control-plane audit logs (IAM/KMS access) for 09:50Z-11:00Z. last audit export shows a gap for 10:00-10:10Z in our retention index. can someone confirm?

audit-bot: Audit export check: control-plane-audit index contains entries up to 09:58Z and resumes at 10:12Z. Missing chunk 10:00Z-10:12Z. Initiating immediate rehydration attempt from raw syslog archives.

olivia.support: customer impact summary I drafted: ~120 distinct API keys hit elevated errors, majority transient after 10:06Z reroute. One enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported data-delivery failure; support case #CS-8897 opened.

jena.prod: thanks @olivia.support. product wants a post-incident review scheduled and a visible action list for customers. Can we get a PM-led postmortem tomorrow? @maria.platform @alex.sre

alex.sre: yes, propose 2024-03-29 16:00Z for 60m postmortem. I'll prepare timeline + initial RCA notes.

maria.platform: that works for me. I'll add deployment/scale metrics.

samir.sec: from security/compliance perspective we need:
- preserve all evidence (S3 path output + raw syslog export)
- investigate audit log gap root cause (ingest pipeline vs retention bug)
- collect operator session recordings for 09:55-10:15Z (for forensic)
- produce chain-of-custody note for evidence bundle

please assign owners. compliance wants this by EOD Friday.

alex.sre: assigning owners inline:
- evidence bundle + manifest: @audit-bot (verify) + @maria.platform (upload verify)
- audit gap investigation: @samir.sec (lead) + @infra-tooling
- operator session collection: @infra-tooling (runbook exec)
- customer impact summary & comms: @olivia.support + @jena.prod
- postmortem doc and action items: @alex.sre

samir.sec: opened ticket SEC-125 for audit-gap investigation and collection tasks. initial hypothesis: transient ingestion lag in audit pipeline when router churn peaked; could be dropped messages in the collector.

audit-bot: Evidence upload complete. Manifest:
- s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/controller-logs.tar.gz
- s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/generator-3-logs.txt
- s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/router-access.log
- syslog-raw-archive rehydration in progress (expected 10-20m)

alex.sre: thanks. can someone run a quick index query to verify no user-data was present in logs (PII check) before we hand off the bundle to security? small command:

``
# grep for email patterns
zgrep -E "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" controller-logs.tar.gz | head
```

maria.platform: ran grep, no obvious emails in controller logs. router-access has some API key ids — those will be redacted before wider sharing.

samir.sec: note: do NOT redact anything until we take a full forensic snapshot in case we need original records. Redaction only on copies for comms. Chain-of-custody must be preserved.

olivia.support: customer comms plan: send initial status update to impacted customers now, promise postmortem and ETA for next update in 24 hours. I'll post a template in #support-templates and tag affected customers.

jena.prod: action items recap (will add to postmortem doc):
- INF-3245: Runbook update: prevent autoscaler race that may cause OOMKilled (owner: @maria.platform) — due 2024-04-05
- SEC-125: Audit ingest pipeline investigation (owner: @samir.sec) — due 2024-03-29 EOD
- PM-88: Postmortem doc + timeline (owner: @alex.sre) — due 2024-03-29 before meeting
- OPS-412: Evidence chain-of-custody and storage hardening (owner: @infra-tooling) — due 2024-04-02

alex.sre: I'll create the postmortem doc in the incidents drive and invite folks. calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/pm-postmortem-1714259200 (placeholder)

samir.sec: also raising a compliance ticket to request KMS access logs for the period and a key-access audit. SEC-126 created.

audit-bot: syslog-raw-archive rehydration complete. Upload at s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1714259200/syslog-raw.tar.gz

alex.sre: verified upload and checksum match. Manifest + checksums committed to SEC-125.

olivia.support: customer impact final: 118 API keys affected, majority with transient errors. Escalated account acme-corp (CS-8897). Support team will patch customers with postmortem link when ready.

maria.platform: quick note on mitigation: autoscaler and generator memory limits adjusted to prevent immediate recurrence; will ring-fence in a canary before rollout.

jena.prod: thanks everyone. next steps: prepare PM notes, security to finish audit-gap RCA, ops to secure evidence and update runbook. We'll close the incident channel after postmortem meeting and when action items are created in the tracker.

alex.sre: ack :white_check_mark:. I'll follow up with the postmortem doc and action item tickets. If anything new surfaces call me @alex.sre immediately.

olivia.support: closing customer loop: outbound updates scheduled at +6h and +24h.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (traffic rerouted). Postmortem scheduled. Incident closed for paging. Thread archived.
